name: iPhone 18 Pro Max
summary: Announced 9 September 2026 and on sale from 18 September, with the 2 nm A20 Pro, a variable-aperture main camera and Apple's C2 modem. Early reviews (Engadget, 9to5Mac) describe a strong but incremental update; no independent benchmark of retail units is recorded here yet, so performance confidence stays low.
highlights: Up to 45 h video playback (eSIM models)

charging.claim: Up to 50% in about 15 min wired; 50% in 30 min on MagSafe
